description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Tiposi is developing a portable microwave-imaging helmet for point-of-care brain scanning. The Associate/Junior Software Engineer will maintain and improve its existing software stack by reproducing and fixing bugs, implementing well-scoped features, and supporting device software in lab, manufacturing, and deployment settings.
Associate/Junior Software Engineer supporting device software through cross-stack debugging, feature implementation, and hardware-in-the-loop verification

Responsibilities:
• Diagnose and fix bugs across the software stack, from technician, clinician, or Jira reports through reproduction, root-cause analysis, implementation, and hardware verification
• Use device emulators and real hardware to reproduce software issues and determine which system layer is responsible
• Implement well-scoped features defined with senior engineers, such as diagnostic pages, API fields, tablet settings, database columns, and migrations
• Navigate and modify large, organically developed codebases, including modules with thousands of lines of code and limited documentation
• Perform hardware-in-the-loop verification using device emulators, physical devices, and manufacturing test procedures
• Support engineering lab and manufacturing-floor troubleshooting
• Help determine whether device issues originate from software, firmware, antennas, hardware, or another subsystem and escalate with clear, reproducible documentation when appropriate
• Improve code quality incrementally by adding tests, documentation, logging, and other maintainability improvements to the areas you work on
• Build and package device software using tools such as PyInstaller and Docker
• Build Android application releases and assist with firmware and application updates across deployed devices
• Support software installation, deployment, troubleshooting, and verification at clinical, manufacturing, and partner sites when required
• Write clear bug reports, verification notes, technical documentation, and engineering hand-offs
• Collaborate with senior software, hardware, firmware, signal-processing, manufacturing, and clinical teams
• Travel internationally as needed to support device deployments, manufacturing operations, clinical sites, technical troubleshooting, and other engineering needs

Requirements:
• 1–3 years of software engineering experience, or strong new graduate experience through relevant internships, academic projects, or technical work
• Strong Python fundamentals and the ability to confidently read, debug, and modify large existing Python modules
• Experience using debuggers, stack traces, logs, and other tools to systematically isolate software problems
• Strong ability to navigate unfamiliar codebases and understand code you did not originally write
• Basic SQL skills and a working understanding of relational databases, including joins, indexes, migrations, and basic query-performance concepts
• Git fluency and good pull-request practices, including small commits, clear commit messages, and responsiveness to code review
• Careful and methodical debugging skills, with an emphasis on identifying root causes and clearly documenting what has and has not been verified
• Clear written English for bug reports, technical documentation, and engineering hand-offs

Preferred:
• Experience with Flask or another Python web framework
• Familiarity with REST APIs and Swagger/OpenAPI
• Experience with Flutter/Dart or another mobile application framework
• Familiarity with MQTT, WebSockets, or other real-time messaging technologies
• Experience using NumPy or pandas to inspect or analyze time-series or sensor data
• Frontend development experience with JavaScript, Bootstrap, Vue, or similar technologies
• Experience with Docker and containerized development workflows
• Familiarity with AWS services such as S3 or RDS
• Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and software release processes
• Experience with healthcare, regulated software, medical devices, or health-tech startups
• Python
• Dart (Flutter)
• JavaScript
